key_claims: Bin Ladin's heightened public profile may presage an attack.
A 10-minute videotape of Bin Ladin was described as the widest public airing.
Bin Ladin's May 1998 press conference preceded the East Africa bombings by months.
Bin Ladin may be trying to profit from attention to the Israeli-Palestinian struggle and reassert his importance as a backer of Islamic causes.
Bin Ladin appeared in two videos about his son's wedding in Jan and Feb 2001, the second including a poem praising the USS Cole attack.
